annotations.title: Block a task with a question

description: Mark a task (or step) blocked when you can't continue without the person (a decision, missing info, access). Returns the question and the exact taskhold_updates call to wait with. Write the reason as one question they can answer from the board in a line, e.g. "Decide: drop the legacy column or keep it nullable?". When the answer is a choice, pass 2-4 short options (and recommended, the index of the one you'd pick, 0 = first): the person answers with one tap and the reply reads Reply to "<question>": chose "<option>". if_no_answer says what you'll do if nobody answers. The board shows it under Needs you and their reply arrives as a note. Then wait for it with taskhold_updates {task_id, since, wait: 50}; keep working on anything that doesn't depend on it meanwhile. If the reply doesn't settle it, block again with a narrower question; don't guess. Blocking an already-blocked task asks the new question instead, and the earlier question stays in the task's history; an unknown task_id fails with "Task not found".

if_no_answer.description: What you will do if nobody answers, e.g. "I'll use SQLite and keep going in 30 min."

options.description: 2-4 short choices shown as buttons, e.g. ["Postgres", "SQLite", "Ask me later"]. Omit for an open question.

reason.description: One answerable question, e.g. "Approve: deploy the migration to staging now?"

recommended.description: Index into options of the one you recommend (0 = the first). Marked on the board.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to block
